significance: A Shiva temple in Mutholy panchayat about 3 km from Pala, founded according to the article by Chonar Chettiar of the Chathamplackal family and now held by the Namboothiri families of the Puliyannoor Oorayma Temple Devaswom. Ganapathi, Yogeeswara, Sastha, the Nagas, Krishna, Devi and Yakshiyamma are worshipped alongside.
